public.how.lead: Yawanci ana shigar da mataki da hannu, don haka yana nuna sabuntawa ta ƙarshe ne kawai. A nan ana samo shi daga yanayin da aka auna, kuma ana adana hujjar kowane sauyi.

public.step.1.body: Ana adana gonaki, filaye, amfanin gona da ranakun shuka a Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Ɗauko yanayin da aka samu
public.step.2.body: Ana ɗauko zafin kowace rana a wurin filin daga tarihin Open-Meteo, tun daga shuka zuwa yau.
public.step.3.title: Tara heat units
public.step.3.body: Ana tara heat units (GDD) bisa lissafin amfanin gona. Idan jimillar ta kai adadin da aka sa, tsarin zai matsar da kakar zuwa mataki na gaba ya kuma rubuta dalilin.

public.models.lead: Heat units da ake buƙata kafin amfanin gona ya nuna. An rubuta waɗannan ƙa'idoji da hannu, kuma ba su da madogara tukuna.

public.honesty.1.body: Har sai mai aiki ya rubuta amfanin gona, manhajar za ta nuna “Ba a rubuta ba”.
public.honesty.2.title: Ma'aunan kwatance bayanai ne dabam
public.honesty.2.body: Ana ajiye ƙididdigar yanki da ta ƙasa a takardunsu dabam, tare da tushe da ma'auni. Ba a kwatanta su da amfanin gona na wata gona.

public.honesty.4.title: Yanayi na kai-tsaye ne
public.honesty.4.body: Ana ɗauko yanayin zafi daga rumbun Open-Meteo a lokacin da aka nema.

public.about.title: Bayani
public.about.heading: Game da Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis manhaja ce ta bibiyar gonaki da amfanin gona a wata gona a Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Dalilin ƙirƙirarta
public.about.why.body: Bayanan matakin girma sukan tsufa, kuma ana rubuta amfanin gona daga ƙwaƙwalwa. Mecropolis tana lissafa matakin girma daga bayanan yanayi da aka rubuta. Kowace lamba tana fitowa daga mai aiki ko wani sanannen tushe na jama'a.
public.about.design.title: Tsari
public.about.design.1.body: Ana tara heat units (GDD) daga ranar shuka ta amfani da rumbun Open-Meteo. Duk lokacin da mataki ya canza, ana ajiye hujjarsa: ranar da ya fara aiki, jimillar GDD da abin da aka lissafa shi daga gare shi.
public.about.design.2.body: Ana kiran matakin bayan shirin girbi balagar zafi, domin ba a rubuta cewa an yi girbi ba.
public.about.design.3.lead: Mai aiki ne ke rubuta amfanin gona.
public.about.design.4.lead: Ma'aunan kwatance don ƙarin bayani ne.
public.about.design.4.body: Ana ajiye su a takardunsu dabam, tare da tushe, ma'auni da lasisi.
public.about.stack.title: Fasahohin da aka yi amfani da su
public.about.stack.body: Manhajar shafi ɗaya ce ta Vite da React 19 a Cloudflare Pages. Burauza tana karanta bayanan Sanity na jama'a kai-tsaye ta GROQ da mai sauraron sauye-sauye na kai-tsaye. Rubutawa da bayanan da ke buƙatar maɓalli suna bi ta Cloudflare Pages Functions, waɗanda ke duba kukin zaman da aka sa wa hannu. Ana amfani da Zod wajen shiga da fitar bayanai, Vitest don gwaji, da Tailwind 4 don ado.
public.about.limits.title: Abubuwan da ba su cika ba
public.about.limits.1: An saita ma'aunan tsarin amfanin gona da hannu (zafin tushe, heat units zuwa tsiro da balaga), kuma har yanzu ba su da tushe.
public.about.limits.2: Ma'aunin kwatancen lupin daga HarvestStat na shekarun 2000 zuwa 2007 ne kawai, kuma aikin farko bai samo takardun ma'aunin lupin ba.
public.about.limits.3: Bayanan kwari bayanan ganin halittu ne na GBIF kusa da gona. Suna nuna inda aka ga wani nau'in halitta kusa da gona.
public.about.limits.4: Gwajin yana da bayanan shiga guda da kowa ke amfani da su, da mai takaita yawan buƙatu da ke cikin ƙwaƙwalwa. Shiga yana ɓoye shafukan dashboard, amma ba ya kare bayanan: kowa na iya karanta rumbun bayanan. Amma yana kare duk wani rubutu.

docs.stages.title: Tsarin matakai
docs.stages.intro: Kakar noma tana bi ta matakai shida:
docs.stages.guards: Kowane sauyin mataki yana da sharadi. Matakin an shuka yana buƙatar ranar shuka da amfanin gona; matakin girma yana buƙatar adadin heat units na fitowar tsiro; shirin girbi yana buƙatar 90% na adadin balaga; balagar zafi tana buƙatar kaiwa adadin balaga; dubawa tana buƙatar bayanan yanayin kakar da tabbataccen ma'aunin kwatance. Sharuɗɗan GDD kuma suna buƙatar bayanan zafi na aƙalla 90% na lokacin, kuma ba a yarda da sauyin da ranar fara aikinsa take nan gaba ba.

docs.seed.body: {0} yana saka gonar gwaji, filaye, amfanin gona da lokutan noma a ma'ajiyar bayanan da aka saita, sannan ya daidaita bayanan kwatancen yankin. Zai maye gurbin gona, filaye da amfanin gona, don haka ka yi shi ne kawai a ma'ajiyar bayanan da ke naka.
guide.title: Yadda ake amfani da Mecropolis
guide.lead: Gajeriyar jagora da kalmomi masu sauƙi. Ta bayyana amfanin manhajar, waɗanda aka yi wa ita da aikin kowane ɓangarenta.
guide.what.title: Mene ne Mecropolis?
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis na bibiyar filaye da amfanin gona. Yana lissafa ci gaban kowane amfanin gona ta tara zafin da ya samu tun daga shuka. Haka kuma, yana nuna yanayi, ƙasa da kwarin da ke kusa da gonarka a wuri ɗaya.
guide.what.p2: An yi shi ne don gonakin Western Cape a Afirka ta Kudu, amma yana aiki ga kowace gona, kowane yanki da kowane lokacin noma.
guide.who.title: Wa aka yi wa shi?
guide.who.p1: An yi shi ne ga mai kula da filaye, kamar manomi, manajan gona ko mai ba su shawara.
guide.who.p2: Ba sai ka san kwamfuta ko ilimin yanayi ba. Idan kana iya buɗe shafin intanet, za ka iya amfani da Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Dalilin amfani da shi
guide.why.1: Za ka iya ganin amfanin gonar da aka shuka yanzu, masu girma da waɗanda suka kusa nuna.
guide.why.2: Ba sai ka sabunta kowane fili da hannu ba. Manhajar tana matsar da amfanin gona zuwa mataki na gaba idan yanayi ya nuna lokaci ya yi.
guide.why.3: Tana faɗakar da kai game da sanyi mai daskarewa da zafi a kwanaki masu zuwa, da kuma kwarin da aka gani kusa da gonarka.
guide.why.4: Duk bayanin fili, kamar feshin da aka yi, kwarin da aka gani ko rubutu, yana zama a wuri ɗaya tare da kwanan wata domin ka duba daga baya.
guide.why.5: Kowane adadi yana nuna inda aka samo shi, domin ka san wanda za ka yarda da shi.
guide.heat.title: Yadda manhajar ke sanin matakin amfanin gona
guide.heat.p1: Tsirrai suna saurin girma idan akwai ɗumi, su yi jinkiri idan akwai sanyi. Kowace rana Mecropolis yana lissafa wannan ɗumi a matsayin ma'aunin zafi, wanda masana ke kira growing degree days ko GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Kowace rana yana ɗaukar matsakaicin mafi yawan zafi da mafi ƙarancin zafi, sannan ya cire zafin da amfanin gonar ba ya girma a ƙasansa. Abin da ya rage shi ne ma'aunin zafin ranar. Ranar sanyi ba ta ƙara komai.
guide.heat.p3: Kowane amfanin gona yana buƙatar wani jimillar ma'aunin zafi kafin ya nuna. Yayin da jimillar tun daga shuka ke kusantar wannan adadi, amfanin gonar yana matsawa zuwa mataki na gaba.
guide.heat.p4: Ana samun bayanan zafin daga Open-Meteo, sabis na yanayi kyauta da ke adana yanayin ko'ina a duniya.
guide.stages.title: Matakai shida
guide.stages.intro: Kowane amfanin gona a kowane fili yana bi ta waɗannan matakai a jere.
guide.stages.planning: An shirya lokacin noma, amma ba a shuka amfanin gonar ba tukuna.
guide.stages.growing: Amfanin gonar yana tara ma'aunin zafi.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Amfanin gonar ya tara yawancin zafin da yake buƙata, don haka lokacin shirin girbi ya yi.
guide.stages.harvested: Amfanin gonar ya tara duk zafin da yake buƙata, don haka ya kamata ya nuna. Kai kaɗai ne za ka tabbatar an girbe shi, saboda haka manhajar tana kiran wannan nuna saboda zafi.
guide.stages.review: Lokacin noma ya ƙare, kuma za ka iya duba yadda ya gudana.
guide.stages.p2: Manhajar tana duba kowane amfanin gona kowane dare da duk lokacin da aka ƙara abin da aka gani ko aikin da aka yi. Haka kuma, za ka iya danna Reconcile now a lokacin noma domin a duba nan take.
guide.start.title: Yadda za a fara
guide.start.1: Buɗe shafin farko. Za ka iya ganin taswirar yanayi, ƙasa, kwari da amfanin gonar gwaji ba tare da shiga asusu ba.
guide.start.2: Danna Sign in a sama, sannan ka yi amfani da bayanan asusun gwajin da aka ba ka.
guide.start.3: Zaɓi gona. Wannan zai buɗe shafin bayanan gonar.
guide.start.4: Danna lokacin noma domin ganin duk bayanan amfanin gona ɗaya a fili ɗaya.
guide.start.5: Yi amfani da akwatin harshe a saman kowane shafi domin canja harshe. Manhajar za ta tuna zaɓinka a gaba.
guide.home.title: Shafin farko
guide.home.p1: Shafin farko yana nuna taswirar yankin mai launuka bisa yawan zafin da ƙasar ta samu a wannan lokacin noma. Haka kuma, yana nuna yanayin yanzu da na kwanaki masu zuwa, ƙasar gonar gwaji, kwarin da aka gani kusa kwanan nan da matsakaicin amfanin yankin. Ba sai ka shiga asusu ba domin ganin su.
guide.dashboard.title: Shafin bayanan gona
guide.dashboard.intro: Wannan shafi yana nuna gona ɗaya. Ga ɓangarorinsa daga sama zuwa ƙasa. Akwatin gona da ke sama yana ba ka damar komawa wata gona.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Taƙaitaccen bayanin gona
guide.dashboard.summary: Yawan filaye da ha na gonar, yawan lokutan noma da ke gudana da yawan amfanin gonar da suka nuna.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Abin da ke buƙatar kulawa
guide.dashboard.alerts: Gajerun faɗakarwa, kamar sanyi mai daskarewa ko zafi a hasashen yanayi, amfanin gonar da ya nuna, lokacin noma da bai fara kan lokaci ba, ko kwarin da aka gani kusa da fili. Kowace faɗakarwa tana faɗin abin da ya jawo ta.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Halin gona
guide.dashboard.conditions: Yanayin yau, hasashen yanayi, ƙasa da kwarin da ke kusa da gonar nan.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Ci gaban lokacin noma
guide.dashboard.progress: Kati na kowane amfanin gona da ke nuna yawan zafin da ya tara. Za ka iya kwatanta filaye a gefe da gefe, sannan ka sauke jerin a matsayin fayil ɗin jadawali (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Filaye
guide.dashboard.fields: Duk filayen gonar tare da girmansu, ƙasarsu da amfanin gonarsu.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Nemo bayanai
guide.dashboard.search: Rubuta abin da kake nema da kalmomi na yau da kullum, kamar ƙwari masu tsotsar ruwan alkama. Zai nemo abubuwan da aka gani da ayyukan da ma'anarsu ɗaya ce, ko da an yi amfani da wasu kalmomi.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Shawarwari
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Ayyukan da aka ba da shawarar yi a fili, kamar feshi ko taki. Za ka iya amincewa ko ƙin kowanne, sannan ka sa alamar an gama idan an kammala aikin.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Ayyukan baya-bayan nan
guide.dashboard.activity: Jerin lokacin da kowane amfanin gona ya koma sabon mataki.
guide.season.title: Shafin lokacin noma
guide.season.intro: Lokacin noma shi ne amfanin gona ɗaya a fili ɗaya cikin shekara ɗaya. Shafinsa yana ɗauke da duk bayanansa.
guide.season.top.label: Saman shafi
guide.season.top: Amfanin gona, fili, ranar shuka, ranar girbin da ake sa ran yi da yawan amfanin bayan ka shigar da shi.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Jerin matakai
guide.season.pipeline: Matakai shida tare da alamar matakin yanzu. Danna Reconcile now domin a duba nan take ko ya kamata amfanin gonar ya matsa gaba.
guide.season.readiness.label: Shirye-shiryen matsawa gaba
guide.season.readiness: Jerin abubuwan da manhajar ke buƙata kafin ta matsar da amfanin gona gaba, kamar ranar shuka da isassun bayanan yanayi. Kowane abu yana nuna Pass, Warning ko Blocked. Idan an toshe, zai faɗi abin da ya rasa.
guide.season.evidence.label: Hujjoji
guide.season.evidence: Bayanan da manhajar ta yi amfani da su wajen yanke shawara, domin ka duba su.
guide.season.propose.label: Ba da shawara
guide.season.propose: Ba da shawarar aikin da za a yi a filin nan tare da hujjojin lokacin noma. Zai jira a matsayin daftari har sai wani ya amince da shi a shafin bayanan gona.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Jadawalin ma'aunin zafin da ke taruwa tun daga shuka, tare da layin jimillar da amfanin gonar ke buƙata.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Idan fa?
guide.season.whatIf: Gwada ranar shuka da ta fi wuri ko ta fi makara, ko lokacin noma mai ɗumi ko sanyi, ka ga yadda ma'aunin zafi zai canja. Ba za a adana komai ba.
guide.season.summary.label: Taƙaitaccen lokacin noma
guide.season.summary: Taƙaitaccen bayanin lokacin noma da AI ya rubuta. Ka ɗauke shi a matsayin taimako, kuma ka duba bayanan idan wani abu bai yi daidai ba.
guide.season.notes.label: Rubutun lokacin noma
guide.season.notes: Rubutu mai kwanan wata na lokacin noma. Za ka iya ƙarawa, canjawa ko gogewa, sannan ka dawo da tsohuwar sigar rubutu.
guide.season.files.label: Hoton fili da rahoton gwajin ƙasa
guide.season.files: Loda hoton fili da PDF na gwajin ƙasa daga ɗakin gwaje-gwaje.
guide.season.log.label: Littafin ayyukan fili
guide.season.log: Abin da ka gani a fili da abin da ka yi masa, kamar feshi tare da sunan magani da adadin da aka yi amfani da shi.
guide.season.history.label: Tarihin gyare-gyare
guide.season.history: Duk canjin da aka adana a wannan lokacin noma tare da kwanan watansa.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Kwatancen yankin
guide.season.benchmark: Matsakaicin amfanin yankin daga ƙididdigar jama'a. Don kwatantawa ne kawai, ba yawan amfanin filinka ba ne.
guide.season.pests.label: Rahotannin kwarin yankin
guide.season.pests: Kwarin da aka ruwaito kusa da filin a GBIF, ma'ajiyar rahotannin gani ta jama'a. Danna Fetch sightings domin samun na baya-bayan nan.
guide.sources.title: Inda aka samo adadin
guide.sources.weather: Ana samun yanayin yau, hasashen yanayi da na kwanakin baya daga Open-Meteo.
guide.sources.soil: Ana samun bayanan ƙasa daga SoilGrids, taswirar ƙasar duniya.
guide.sources.pests: Ana samun rahotannin ganin kwari daga GBIF, ma'ajiyar rahotannin gani ta jama'a.
guide.sources.yields: Ana samun yawan amfanin yankin daga USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa da World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Sauran bayanai, kamar rubutu, ayyukan da aka yi da yawan amfanin gonarka, kai ko tawagarka ne kuka shigar da su.
guide.limits.title: Abin da ba zai iya yi ba
guide.limits.model: Ma'aunin zafin da muka ƙiyasta kowane amfanin gona yana buƙata ba a gwada shi a fili ba. Yi amfani da shi a matsayin jagora, amma ka fi yarda da abin da ka gani a filinka.
guide.limits.maturity: Balagar zafi na nufin yanayi ya nuna amfanin gona ya isa girbi. Kai kaɗai ka san ko ya isa da gaske.
guide.limits.translation: AI ne ya yi fassarar. Ya kamata ta kasance mai sauƙin fahimta, amma ba a sa ɗan asalin kowane harshe ya duba ta ba.
guide.limits.demo: Kowa na iya amfani da gwajin, don haka kada ka saka bayanan sirri.
